node_kinds.name: A2A_Ecosystem
node_kinds.description: Root of a collected A2A agent ecosystem (one collection scope, such as an organization, a registry or a set of discovered domains). Plays the role a Domain plays in Active Directory.

node_kinds.name: A2A_Provider
node_kinds.description: Organization that publishes one or more agents, from AgentCard.provider (organization, url).

node_kinds.name: A2A_Agent
node_kinds.description: An A2A agent described by an Agent Card (/.well-known/agent-card.json, or /.well-known/agent.json before v1.0). Carries the card's top-level fields, capability flags and default input/output modes as properties.

node_kinds.name: A2A_Interface
node_kinds.description: One endpoint an agent is reachable at, from AgentCard.supportedInterfaces[] (url, protocolBinding, protocolVersion, tenant), or url/preferredTransport/additionalInterfaces[] on pre-v1.0 cards.

node_kinds.name: A2A_Host
node_kinds.description: A network origin (scheme://host:port) that serves agent interfaces or API operations. The main correlation point between Agent Cards and OpenAPI documents, and the node to mark as owned when a server is compromised.

node_kinds.name: A2A_Skill
node_kinds.description: A capability an agent offers, from AgentCard.skills[] (id, name, description, tags, examples, inputModes, outputModes, securityRequirements).

node_kinds.name: A2A_Extension
node_kinds.description: A protocol extension an agent supports, from AgentCard.capabilities.extensions[] (uri, description, required, params). Keyed by uri so agents sharing an extension converge on one node.

node_kinds.name: A2A_SecurityScheme
node_kinds.description: An authentication mechanism declared in AgentCard.securitySchemes or OpenAPI components.securitySchemes: apiKey, http (basic/bearer), oauth2, openIdConnect or mutualTls.

node_kinds.name: A2A_AuthorizationServer
node_kinds.description: An OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect issuer, derived from tokenUrl, authorizationUrl, oauth2MetadataUrl or openIdConnectUrl. Agents and APIs that trust the same issuer converge on one node, the way computers converge on a Domain Controller.

node_kinds.name: A2A_Scope
node_kinds.description: An OAuth scope issued by an authorization server, from oauth2 flows[].scopes. Keyed by issuer plus scope name.

node_kinds.name: A2A_Client
node_kinds.description: A credential-holding identity that calls agents or APIs: an OAuth client, service account, API key holder or mTLS client certificate. Not in Agent Cards themselves; added from IdP exports, gateway config or agent deployment config.

node_kinds.name: A2A_PublicAccess
node_kinds.description: Well-known node for unauthenticated callers. Linked to every agent, skill or operation with no security requirement, like Everyone or Anonymous Logon in Active Directory. One per ecosystem.

node_kinds.name: A2A_SigningKey
node_kinds.description: A key that signs Agent Cards, from AgentCard.signatures[].protected (decoded JWS header: kid, alg, jku). Keyed by jku plus kid.

node_kinds.name: A2A_APISpec
node_kinds.description: An OpenAPI (openapi.json) document: info.title, info.version, openapi version, servers[], tags[].

node_kinds.name: A2A_APIOperation
node_kinds.description: One method + path in an OpenAPI document (operationId, summary, tags, deprecated, x-* fields). Keyed by server origin, method and path template.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_Contains
relationship_kinds.description: Structural membership: Ecosystem to Provider, Agent, Host, AuthorizationServer, APISpec and PublicAccess; Provider to Agent.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_Publishes
relationship_kinds.description: Provider operates the agent (AgentCard.provider). Traversable: whoever controls the provider organization controls its agents.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_HostsInterface
relationship_kinds.description: Host serves this agent interface (interface url origin equals host). Compromising the host compromises the interface.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_ServesAgent
relationship_kinds.description: Interface is a live endpoint of the agent. Control of the interface gives control of the agent's traffic.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_HasSkill
relationship_kinds.description: Agent offers the skill. Whoever can invoke or control the agent can invoke the skill.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_SupportsExtension
relationship_kinds.description: Agent declares the protocol extension in capabilities.extensions[]. Property required marks mandatory extensions.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_HostsOperation
relationship_kinds.description: Host serves the API operation (OpenAPI servers[] origin equals host).

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_DefinesOperation
relationship_kinds.description: OpenAPI document defines the operation.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_DescribedBy
relationship_kinds.description: Agent or interface is documented by the OpenAPI document (same origin as servers[], or linked through documentationUrl or an x-openapi field).

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_BackedBy
relationship_kinds.description: Skill is implemented by the API operation, correlated by matching skill id/name/tags to operationId/tags/path, or by explicit mapping. Invoking the skill exercises the operation.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_ProtectedBy
relationship_kinds.description: Agent, skill, interface or operation requires the security scheme (securityRequirements / security). Edge properties: scopes (required scope list) and requirement_group (index of the alternative it belongs to).

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_AuthenticatesTo
relationship_kinds.description: Holding a valid credential for this security scheme grants access to the target agent, skill, interface or operation. Emitted from the scheme for each requirement it satisfies on its own.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_TrustsIssuer
relationship_kinds.description: Security scheme accepts tokens from the authorization server (tokenUrl / openIdConnectUrl / oauth2MetadataUrl issuer).

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_IssuesTokensFor
relationship_kinds.description: Authorization server mints tokens that this security scheme accepts. Compromising the issuer lets an attacker mint access for every scheme that trusts it.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_DefinesScope
relationship_kinds.description: Authorization server issues the scope.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_GrantsAccessTo
relationship_kinds.description: A token carrying this scope satisfies the scope requirement on the target agent, skill or operation.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_HasScope
relationship_kinds.description: Client identity is allowed to request the scope (from IdP client configuration).

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_HoldsCredential
relationship_kinds.description: Client identity holds a credential for the security scheme (API key, bearer secret, client certificate, client secret).

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_RunsAs
relationship_kinds.description: Agent authenticates outbound calls as this client identity. Compromising the agent yields the client's access, like HasSession in Active Directory.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_CanDelegateTo
relationship_kinds.description: Agent is configured to send tasks to another agent (from orchestrator config, registry links or observed traffic).

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_Anonymous
relationship_kinds.description: Unauthenticated callers can reach the target: an agent, skill, interface or operation with no security requirement, or with an interface served over plain http.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_SignsCard
relationship_kinds.description: Signing key signed the agent's card. Whoever holds the key can forge that agent's identity.

relationship_kinds.name: A2A_SameAgentAs
relationship_kinds.description: Two agent nodes describe the same deployed agent (for example the public card and the authenticated extended card, or the same card found under two origins).
